name: sales-unit-picker
title: Sales unit picker
description: Let shoppers buy by the piece, the box, the pallet or by weight: every unit shows its price per piece, switching converts the quantity, and the total is worked out.
docs: Describe the product's units with pieces (how many pieces one holds) and price in minor units; the price per piece, the saving against the smallest pack and the conversion between units all come from those two numbers. A unit's min, step and max are its rules: quantities are multiples of step, at least min, at most max, and a typed number is corrected with a message. Switching unit works from the pieces the shopper asked for and rounds up, never down, so looking at the units never changes the order: switch back and the same quantity returns. Typing, stepping or pushing against a limit is what changes the ask. onChange always carries a quantity the rules allow plus the line total. With mode="weight" pass pricePerKilo and the amounts are grams. units.ts holds the arithmetic and runs on the server too.
